title: Control exception
description: An exception is a control change, not an escape hatch. It changes the INTENDED state for a population subset. No expiry = undocumented control change = rejected by CI.

expires_on.description: Mandatory. CI fails the build on an expired or absent expiry.

compensating.description: control_ids that carry the residual. Empty array is legal but must be deliberate.

coverage_impact.description: Fraction of population removed from intended state. Feeds FAIR-CAM coverage.
